name: agentmash
description: Plugins for teams running many Claude Code agents on one repository, and for running science with them.

plugins.name: agentmash-crew
plugins.description: 18 role agents with a shared crew protocol for parallel Claude Code work on one repository.

plugins.name: agentmash-lab
plugins.description: 6 science agents run by the crew's coordinator: hypotheses with cross-field prior art, pre-registration locks, verified data, registered analyses, controls and an evidence judge.
